heading: Thursday, September 18, 2025
topLine: DeepMind and mathematicians find new families of unstable fluid singularities.

items.headline: DeepMind and mathematicians find new families of unstable fluid singularities
items.summary: A Google DeepMind team, with mathematicians from Brown, NYU and Stanford including Tristan Buckmaster and Javier Gómez-Serrano, used physics-informed neural networks and a high-precision Gauss–Newton optimizer. With them they found new unstable self-similar blow-up solutions for the incompressible porous media, Boussinesq and 3D Euler (with boundary) equations. They also report an empirical formula linking blow-up rate to the order of instability. The solutions are numerical, accurate to near double-precision limits, which the authors say is sufficient for future computer-assisted proofs. No rigorous proof was given yet, and the work does not resolve the Navier–Stokes problem. The preprint has not been peer-reviewed.
